//: NAPlatform core-webui first-run preseed settings (Phase 14; login-required in Phase 15).
The preseed (config/core-webui/preseed.sh) copies this file into the
core-webui state dir ($HERMES_WEBUI_STATE_DIR, default
/home/hermeswebui/.hermes/webui/settings.json) BEFORE core-webui serves, and
writes a setup-completed marker, so localhost:3000 SKIPS the initial setup /
onboarding wizard.
Phase 15: after the setup screen is skipped the UI must NOT land directly in
chat — it must require login first. The login_required / require_auth /
start_page=login keys below make / redirect to /login, and defaults.landing is
'login' (not 'workspace'). core-webui's exact settings schema is owned by the
external repo and may differ; this file therefore declares both the
first-run-disabled semantics (first_run/setup_completed/onboarding_completed/
initial_setup_completed) and the login-required semantics under several
plausible key names so the behavior is robust across versions. Adjust the key
names here if a core-webui version uses a different one — no code change is
needed, this is pure repo-controlled config.
NO SECRETS: passwords, tokens and API keys are NEVER placed in this file. The
login password is supplied to the ui container via the HERMES_WEBUI_PASSWORD /
CORE_WEBUI_PASSWORD env (see docker-compose.yml), NOT here. The session token is
minted by the API at login and kept in browser memory by the adapter
(services/ui/adapter/naplatform-adapter.js).
